svg.title: SATELLITE-X v0.5.0 Top-to-End Architecture
svg.desc: Complete block diagram from users and consent through field onboarding, live acquisition, preprocessing, SAR resilience, analytics, diagnosis, delivery, offline verification, advanced human-gated actions, persistence and external activation.
svg.text: పూర్తి వ్యవస్థ ప్రవాహం · user → field → live data → quality → intelligence → action → verification → governance
GPS నుంచి confirmed operational field వరకు
field quality, all-band checks, safe fallback routing
durable records, audit trail, activation requirements

g.text: never converts SAR into optical indices
parcel evidence only with case ID
approve, reject or request field check
fields · analysis runs · authorizations · access logs · area summaries
offline queue · server receipts · identity sessions · verification events
official API/MoU + credentials · SMS provider · verified yield labels
equipment/field trial · target-device TLS test · local SAR ground labels

svg.text: Frozen safety principle: no legal ownership, diagnosis, yield, OTP, government access, or machinery execution is fabricated when evidence/authorization is absent.
